target.title: fix(android): stabilize shell navigation layout
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Android post-onboarding shell had compact top and bottom navigation text surfaces that could crowd or clip when status text or tab labels were wider than the available phone width.

## Why This Change Was Made

This keeps the active shell layout predictable by bounding the status chip, ellipsizing long text, and centering fixed-height bottom tab labels without changing navigation behavior.

## User Impact

The main Android shell is easier to scan on phone-sized screens, and longer gateway status text is less likely to push the header or bottom navigation out of shape.
